column4: UNIT NAME
CHECK
Verify layouts dwngs match the actual box/console build in terms of: panduct colors, components installed, rel. chgs completed & dwng revs noted. Clarify all differences.
Verify each box/console have their corresponding Data plate.
Door gaskets are intact, door handles are not loose, no visible dents or scratches on doors/box.

Open box to verify content (mod bus cables, software, special keys, software & manuals, etc.) Visually check that all keys (two of each: console, back-up reset, PLC, unit control) are tie wrapped to the inside of the console/box.
When applicable secure the keyboard to the tray using the Velcro
For EP boxes, verify all bolts are accounted for and secured with the box/console.
Ensure Door opening/closing stop bracket hardware is tight.
All unused holes are properly plugged on loose ship boxes.
All shortages are documented in the ATL.
Verify required documentation is scanned into project folder
Verify all screws in use (with terminations) on the shield bus bars and power strips are tight.
Check for loose, exposed or damage Wires/Cables for power supplies, fuses and any other potentially higher energy components.
Ensure horn is secure to the door.
All unused studs are covered.
Check for loose, exposed or damage Wires/Cables. This includes ferrules and lugs (if required).
Ensure panels are clean with no excess torque paint or Penetrox.
All warning labels, outside control labels and Turbotronic plates should be installed.
(TCP, Meter, Switches, etc.) and is the correct language.
Verify all push button and switches are tight and can operate properly.
Verify all meter wiring is tightened.
Ensure horn and counter wires are disconnected for new production equipment.
Harnesses should be secured (clamped).
Ensure all components are placed reasonably and can operate properly.    (i.e. modules can be removed, components can be accessed, etc.)
Ensure communication cables (especially fiber optic) do not exceed the maximum bend radius and are secured with a proper harness (velcro.)
Verify all panels have torque paint applied to mounting bolts or nuts.
Ensure there is a pull wire/cord installed with a pilot tag on consoles (EP Frames).
For boxes, verify torque paint on drain plugs. Verify vent has been replaced with plug.
Ensure Panduct covers are cut to the correct length.
Each component has their corresponding blue label installed, legible and undamaged.
Bonded holes must have Penetrox.
Plexiglas cover is installed over high voltage components.
Grounding Collar Studs are intact.
Verify all grounding bus bars (large copper bars, 5, 8, & 14 designs, used and unused terminations) have all h/w installed and tight. Include: star, lock and std washers.
Verify correct routing.
Labels should be installed in the correct orientation (left to right or bottom to top).
Verify corrections have been made.
Torque -0v, -24v and ground screw terminations to 3.5 in-lb on all AENTR (or equivalent) modules, then perform a pull test.
Enter discrepancy count into BIQ Completed Log.
Scan and upload discrepancy layouts.
Photograph to ensure the SD card has been reinstalled in the PLC module. SD card cover should already be open (do not remove), close cover after pictures.
Take and upload BIQ pictures.
For Consoles ensure all access plates are installed and have the bolts in every hole on both the top and bottom plates.
Ensure bottom of the box/console is clean.
